title: Privacy Chest
description: Simple, secure, and GUI-based chest protection with password and trust systems
body:
**PrivacyChest** is a lightweight chest-protection plugin designed for Survival and SMP servers that allows players to securely lock containers using an intuitive GUI.

Players can lock chests so only authorized users can access them. Instead of relying on signs or long commands, PrivacyChest provides a clean in-game interface to manage permissions quickly and safely.


**Features**

- Lock containers to prevent unauthorized access
- GUI-based access management (no signs or command spam)
- Add or remove trusted players from a container
- Optional password protection for extra security
- Works seamlessly in Survival and multiplayer environments
- Designed for SMP servers where shared bases and trust-based access are common


**Why use PrivacyChest?**
PrivacyChest is ideal for servers that want simple, user-friendly item protection without the complexity of traditional protection mods. It reduces setup time, avoids chat clutter, and makes container security accessible to all players—new and experienced alike.


For setup instructions, configuration details, and developer documentation, visit the GitHub project page: https://github.com/Usama-Balhasal/Privecy-Chest
